meta.name: infinitetalk-shopping-avatar
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在制作数字人带货视频时，使用本技能可自动生成适配InfiniteTalk的五幕分镜结构化提示词，精准管控角色一致性与音画同步，一键产出高质量9:16竖屏带货视频，让数字人带货更高效！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成数字人五幕分镜，产出竖屏带货视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在运营电商或做内容,需要快速制作数字人带货视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate five-act storyboard prompts for digital human shopping videos.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run e-commerce or create content and need quick digital-human shopping videos.

howto.what: 它会为 InfiniteTalk 数字人带货视频生成五幕分镜提示词，每幕 5 秒、共 25 秒，配 9:16 竖屏参数表，并做一致性核查与知识库归档。
howto.when: 当你需要制作小省导购员数字人带货视频、用 InfiniteTalk 推理时触发；场景可为产品推荐、价格对比等。

say.text: 帮我生成产品推荐场景的五幕提示词
say.note: 输出五幕中文提示词和参数配置表

say.text: 核查一下这套提示词的角色一致性
say.note: 返回 pass/fail 质检报告与问题清单

say.text: 把 Suno 音频按 5 秒一幕对齐并编码

howto.what_en: It writes five-act storyboard prompts for InfiniteTalk digital-human shopping videos: 5s per act, 25s total, 9:16 1080×1920, plus a parameter table, quality check and archiving.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a Xiaosheng shopping-guide digital-human video rendered with InfiniteTalk; scenes can be product recommendation, price comparison, etc.

say_en.text: Generate the five-act prompts for a product recommendation scene
say_en.note: Returns five Chinese prompts and a parameter table

say_en.text: Check the character consistency of these prompts
say_en.note: Returns a pass/fail report and issue list

say_en.text: Align the Suno audio to 5s per act and encode it
